title: How Europe's Overregulation of AI and Data Centers Could Hand China the Lead | Opinion
text:
While Europe tightens its regulatory grip on AI and data centers, China is aggressively investing in these technologies to become the global leader by 2030. The US faces a critical decision: embrace innovation to maintain supremacy or risk being overtaken by China's rapid advancements.
Europe's overregulation of AI and data centers could lead to a new great divergence, with China emerging as the global leader in artificial intelligence and shaping the values and vision of the global order.
The US has a choice to make: win the race for AI supremacy by embracing change and innovation, or lose the race by falling into a defensive crouch and allowing China to become the premier global superpower. China is investing heavily in AI and related technologies, with a goal of leading the world in AI by 2030.
